verdict.rationale: 1Password documents saving, creating, managing and signing in with passkeys through its browser extension, so passkeys live in 1Password rather than in one platform vendor's store. The pack does not document passkeys syncing across iOS, Android, Windows and Linux, so cross-ecosystem reach is only implied. missing for 10: explicit documentation of passkey sync and use on iOS, Android, Windows and Linux; native-app (non-browser) passkey use on mobile; independent hands-on corroboration of cross-platform passkey sync.

support.subject: As a power user, my passkeys sync across ecosystems — iOS, Android, Windows, Linux, browsers — instead of being locked to one platform vendor

citations.quote: you can now create, manage, and sign in with passkeys on a growing number of websites and apps directly from the 1Password browser extension
You can use 1Password to save the passkeys you create for your accounts and sign in to websites with passkeys in your browser.
